description: Full Falcon-1024 Keccak3 packing comparison; local measurements, not a cross-machine performance guarantee.
timing_definition: Median of three measured trials after one warmup, fresh process per variant/batch; total prover includes witness generation, commitment, and proof construction, excludes setup/input generation and verification. RSS is process high-water mark across all trials.

validation.vendor_failure_reason: Standalone default Ligerito config at m=22 has initial_k=4, caller requests log_batch_size=6.
